Hibiscus assumes lower treatment before Lancet's absence becomes fatal.

Midnight and Melantha intercept outer traffic and attack eastern devices.

Vanilla survives through the frame-1650 activation.
Outer attackers survive until their direct medical coverage arrives.

handoff_requirements: Fang's retreat immediately precedes Cardigan's deployment.
Durin immediately fills the released slot.
responsibilities: Steward fires throughout actual eastern coverage.
Lava adds return-window arts under Hibiscus.

battle_phases.start_condition: Opening duties remain intact after frame 1800.
survival_dependencies: Fang survives through the frame-3570 income event.
Steward survives without credited baseline healing.
Hibiscus and Lava survive the artillery exchange.
Midnight survives long enough to finish lower eastern clearance.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The frame-6330 final spawn has occurred and all hostile enemies are dead before frame 7800.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Residual hostiles make the scheduled western release unsafe and invalidate acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Retain every corridor and exhaust armored and fast-enemy queues.

Do not equate last spawn with clearance.
responsibilities: Cardigan and Beagle preserve three-block central capacity.

Outer blockers retain officers east of detained civilians.

responsibilities: Fresh Gallus attacks western upper detention.
Fresh 12F attacks western lower detention using only generic single-target damage credit.
Retained medics and central formation remain until acceptance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Hostile clearance is established before frame 7800.

Clearers remain deployed until their devices are destroyed.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.prior_issue: Static action 46 attempted late Gallus deployment without a usable conflict classification.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.resolution: Remove that action entirely. Gallus has exactly one deployment, at frame 7800, after two explicit retreats; no duplicate deployment or tile reuse is assumed.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.prior_issue: Early legal Steward deployment was treated as an early damage window.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.resolution: Deploy at 69 seconds and expect first coverage near frame 2280; retain until 145 seconds.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.prior_issue: Unhealed outer defenders and fragile eastern Gallus were expected to survive handoffs.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.resolution: Assign baseline medical coverage to both outer attackers; use Lava with lower treatment for additional artillery pressure.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward remains through 145 seconds; Lava contributes during the lower eastern return. Require artillery death before Steward's withdrawal.
Melantha clears eastern upper detention. Western detention remains until Gallus's final clearance; Ansel sustains interception east of the civilian.
Midnight clears eastern lower detention before the second civilian reaches it. Western detention remains until 12F's final clearance.
Fang opens; Cardigan inherits at 121 seconds. Durin supplies terminal upper central arts.
Vanilla clears the opening. Beagle takes over at 85 seconds; Lava and Durin exhaust later lower queues.
Melantha retains upper outer traffic throughout combat, with Ansel's treatment and repeated attack skills.
Midnight retains lower outer traffic throughout combat, with Hibiscus's treatment and two arts windows.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception, reciprocal attacks and five budgeted automatic DP grants.
Opening lower central interception and two DP grants; retire at 60 seconds.
Clear eastern lower roadblock and retain lower outer officers under Hibiscus.
Clear eastern upper roadblock and retain upper outer officers under Ansel.
Opening lower treatment and deployment heal; retire before the previous casualty window.
Heal upper central and upper outer defenders, himself and eventual upper central caster.
Heal lower central and lower outer defenders, herself and Lava.
Sustained eastern artillery damage from actual coverage entry through the required kill.
Lower central three-block anchor after Vanilla.
Supported lower eastern artillery pressure followed by lower central arts.
Upper central three-block anchor after Fang; ordinary attacks only.
Sustained arts covering both central blocking tiles after the artillery handoff.
Fresh late caster clearing western upper roadblock.
Fresh late caster clearing western lower roadblock; no splash or dodge credit.

explicit_deadline_basis.basis: The 84-second lower officer requires approximately 7.27 seconds to reach column 5 under the supplied 0.5 movement multiplier. Beagle deploys at frame 2550.
Second civilian spawns at 101 seconds and traverses three columns at effective speed 0.325 before eastern lower detention. This is a model estimate, not client timing.

New falsifiable artillery-clearance requirement. Steward's extended eastern opportunity and Lava's approximately 116-138-second geometric opportunity motivate it; no guaranteed focus or remaining-HP subtraction proves it.
A 49-second clearance allowance after the final modeled spawn, not evidence that all queues will necessarily be empty.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward supplies sustained, previously observed eastern coverage. Lava supplies a separate return-window opportunity from [5,5] RIGHT. Neither receives invented target priority; Lava's lower central targets can compete.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel LEFT covers [1,5], [3,5] and [2,5]. Hibiscus LEFT covers [6,5], [4,5] and [5,5]. Both include their own tiles. They do not provide reciprocal coverage, and neither baseline range covers Steward at [2,7].
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla attack across adjacent central lanes. Midnight and Melantha intercept outer traffic while attacking eastern roadblocks. Lancet bridges opening injury until the assigned medics arrive.
formation_structure.protected_targets: Keep western roadblocks intact during combat. Outer interception at column 5 separates officers from civilians detained near column 2. Release uses fresh casters after the required hostile-clearance event.
formation_structure.terminal: Cardigan and Beagle hold central queues while Durin covers both and Lava covers the lower queue. The original, medically supported outer attackers remain through hostile clearance.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet; Ansel arrives one second later and Hibiscus at 55 seconds.
Withdraw Vanilla after her second grant and required opening queue clearance.
Deploy Steward; this establishes readiness, not immediate artillery damage.
Beagle occupies the vacant lower central tile before the 84-second officer reaches it.
Deploy Lava under lower medical coverage instead of repeating Gallus's fatal 70-second placement.
Retreat Fang, then deploy Cardigan on the same tile in listed order.
After the required artillery kill, withdraw Steward and add central arts with Durin.
After required hostile clearance, withdraw both outer attackers and deploy fresh western roadblock clearers.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true; no reserve units.
DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col], directions are cardinal, and no action occupies [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]]. Maximum concurrent deployment is eight.
Opening ledger excludes refunds and unsupported income. Missing Fang or Vanilla grants invalidate the dependent survival and deployment handoff; do not silently retime actions.
Vanilla's lower queue must be empty at frame 1800. Beagle must occupy [4,5] before subsequent traffic reaches it.
Midnight and Melantha remain effective through hostile clearance; medics must actually treat their assigned corridors. Their deaths are failures when they remove interception or protection.
Both eastern roadblocks must be destroyed before they obstruct the planned civilian transfer, especially lower #4 before approximately frame 3307 under the supplied movement model.
Artillery must be dead by frame 4320, before Steward retreats at 4350. Failure invalidates the scheduled central transition.
No hostile may remain active at frame 7800 before outer withdrawal and western release. This is a falsifiable prerequisite, not an executable conditional action.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Keep officers intercepted outside their 1.2 civilian attack radius; do not count roadblock destruction as a protected arrival.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active hostile enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Survive the four opening corridors, establish assigned medical coverage, obtain only supported opening DP, and clear Vanilla's queue before withdrawal.
Sustain both outer attackers, finish eastern roadblock clearance, establish Beagle and begin Steward's actual eastern firing opportunity.
Lava and Steward pursue artillery clearance; Hibiscus strengthens lower survival at 115. Cardigan inherits upper blocking without a prolonged vacancy.
Maintain four interception points; central arts must prevent armored enemies from occupying block capacity indefinitely.
Exhaust remaining queues after the last spawn. Spawn exhaustion alone does not authorize withdrawals.
Clear western roadblocks after hostile clearance and observe both protected arrivals. Continue observation beyond this planning horizon if acceptance is incomplete.

skill_intents.intent: Budget five +6 grants only while Fang survives and remains continuously deployed through 121 seconds.
Budget only the grants at 25 and 55 seconds; no post-retirement income.
Arts windows at 61 and 171 seconds; respect 40 active seconds followed by 70 charging seconds.
Attack enhancement at 114,174,234 seconds for returning and late outer officers.
Healing enhancement at 69,129,189,249,309,369; baseline upper coverage does not depend on range extension.
Hold first readiness until 115 to support Lava's artillery window; repeat every 50 seconds.
Defense enhancement at 125,195,265,335; exclude unsupported passive DEF.
Deployment SP permits first activation at 119; repeat every 60 seconds. Credit attack speed and generic single-target arts only.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits. No highest-defense priority or passive ATK credit.
Ordinary modeled attacks only; exclude self-healing, dodge, RES reduction and splash geometry.

tactical_thesis: Support both outer interceptors directly, replace exposed central vanguards with durable defenders, and retain Steward throughout the eastern artillery excursion. Move Midnight to [6,5]; face both medics LEFT toward their assigned blockers. Replace the demonstrated fatal early Gallus deployment with medically covered Lava at 109 seconds. Keep western civilian detention intact until hostile clearance, then use two fresh casters for release.
